description: Mobile only. There is a single webview per window on Android/iOS, so the dock (src/embed/dock-embedded.gen.js) runs INSIDE the remote arena.ai page and must be able to subscribe to the Rust events the desktop dock webview receives (arenakit://trace, arenakit://page). The page commands are repeated here (also granted by arena-page.json through the webview label) so the mobile grant is self-contained. Still no arena_command.
